added_items.item: Redis must be configured with maxmemory-policy noeviction (in addition to AOF) or it can drop queued jobs
Postgres risk: heavy job churn creates dead rows/bloat; tune autovacuum and delete finished jobs often
Postgres polling latency can reach ~1s; LISTEN/NOTIFY can reduce it
Redis enqueue is not transactional with the DB, so a crash can lose or duplicate a job; make jobs idempotent
pg-boss and Graphile Worker handle retries, scheduling and delayed jobs
BullMQ features: priorities, repeatable jobs, dashboard ecosystem
